chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad al-Barqī, from Abū Hāshim Dāwūd ibn al-Qāsim al-Jaʿfarī, from Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī (عليه السلام), who said:

Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) came, and with him was al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī (عليه السلام), while he was leaning on the hand of Salmān. He entered al-Masjid al-Ḥarām and sat down, when a man of fine appearance and clothing approached, greeted Amīr al-Muʾminīn, and he returned the greeting. The man sat and then said: “O Amīr al-Muʾminīn, I ask you about three matters. If you inform me of them, I will know that the people have undertaken regarding your affair that which has been decreed against them, and that they are not secure in their worldly life and their Hereafter. But if it is otherwise, I will know that you and they are equal in the matter.”

Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) said to him: “Ask me whatever appears to you.” He said: “Inform me about a man: when he sleeps, where does his spirit go? And about a man: how does he remember and forget? And about a man: how does his child resemble the paternal uncles and the maternal uncles?” Then Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) turned to al-Ḥasan and said: “O Abā Muḥammad, answer him.”

He said: al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام) answered him. Then the man said: “I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I have never ceased bearing witness to it. And I bear witness that Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله), and I have never ceased bearing witness to that. And I bear witness that you are the وصي of the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) and the one who upholds his proof”—and he pointed to Amīr al-Muʾminīn—“and I have never ceased bearing witness to it. And I bear witness that you are his وصي and the one who upholds his proof”—and he pointed to al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام)—“and I bear witness that al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī is the وصي of his brother and the one who upholds his proof after him.”

And I bear witness concerning ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn that he is the one who upholds the affair of al-Ḥusayn after him. And I bear witness concerning Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī that he is the one who upholds the affair of ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn. And I bear witness concerning Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad that he is the one who upholds the affair of Muḥammad. And I bear witness concerning Mūsā that he is the one who upholds the affair of Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad. And I bear witness concerning ʿAlī ibn Mūsā that he is the one who upholds the affair of Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar. And I bear witness concerning Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī that he is the one who upholds the affair of ʿAlī ibn Mūsā. And I bear witness concerning ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad that he is the one who upholds the affair of Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī.

And I bear witness concerning al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī that he is the one who upholds the affair of ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad. And I bear witness concerning a man from the offspring of al-Ḥasan, who is neither given a teknonym nor named until his affair becomes manifest; then he will fill it with justice just as it had been filled with injustice. And peace be upon you, O Amīr al-Muʾminīn, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.”

Then he stood and departed. So Amīr al-Muʾminīn said: “O Abā Muḥammad, follow him and see where he is heading.” So al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī (عليه السلام) went out and said: “It was only that he placed his foot outside the mosque, and I did not know where he had gone in the earth of Allah.” So I returned to Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) and informed him. He said: “O Abā Muḥammad, do you know him?” I said: “Allah, His Messenger, and Amīr al-Muʾminīn know best.” He said: “He is al-Khiḍr (عليه السلام).”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Title of Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام), presented here as the rightful divine authority.
key_terms.الْأَخْوَالَ: The maternal uncles, referenced in resemblance of offspring.
key_terms.الْأَعْمَامَ: The paternal uncles, referenced in resemblance of offspring.
key_terms.الْخَضِرُ: Al-Khiḍr (عليه السلام), identified as the mysterious visitor.
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ بِحُجَّتِهِ: The one who upholds the divine proof and authority after the previous Imam.
key_terms.رُوحُهُ: His spirit, mentioned in the question about sleep and the state of the soul.
key_terms.عَدْلًا: Justice, describing how the final Imam will fill the earth.
key_terms.وَصِيُّ: The designated successor entrusted with religious authority after the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith from al-Kāfī present the names and succession of the twelve Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates a meeting in al-Masjid al-Ḥarām in which a mysterious man tests Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام), then bears witness to the succession of the twelve Imams. The report is significant in Shia creed for its explicit designation of the Imams and its conclusion that the visitor was al-Khiḍr (عليه السلام), affirming their divine authority and the awaited rise of the final Imam.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al Barqy, from Abu Hashim Dawood Bin al Qasim Al Ja’fary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> the 2<sup>nd</sup> 
having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> came over and with him<sup>asws</sup> was Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> was leaning upon the hand of Salman<sup>as</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> entered the Sacred Masjid and sat down, and a man of good personality and clothing came and greeted upon Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> returned the greetings, and he sat down, then said, ‘O Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>! I shall ask you<sup>asws</sup> three questions. If you<sup>asws</sup> were to inform me with these, I shall know that the people who are going against your<sup>asws</sup> command, it is what would be Judged against them and that they are not with safety in their world and in their Hereafter; and if it happens to be other, I shall know that you<sup>asws</sup> and they are equal in Law’. 
So Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘Ask me<sup>asws</sup> about whatever comes to you’. He said, ‘Inform me about the man when he sleeps, where does his spirit go? And about the man, how does he remember and forget? And about the man, how do his children resemble the paternal uncles and the maternal uncles?’ So Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> turned towards Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>! Answer him’. 
He (Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> the 2<sup>nd</sup>) said: ‘So Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> answered him, and the man said, ‘I testify that there is no god except for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and I shall not cease testifying with it, and I testify that Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> is Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and I shall not cease testifying with it, and I testify that you<sup>asws</sup> are a successor<sup>asws</sup> of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and establisher with his<sup>saww</sup> Divine Authority’, and he indicated towards Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, ‘And I shall not cease testifying with it, and I testify that you<sup>asws</sup> are his<sup>saww</sup> successor<sup>asws</sup>’, and he indicated towards Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> , ‘And I testify that Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> is a successor<sup>asws</sup> of his<sup>asws</sup> brother<sup>asws</sup> and the establisher with his<sup>asws</sup> Divine Authority after him<sup>asws</sup>.
And I testify upon Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup> is the establisher with the command of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> after him<sup>asws</sup>, and I testify upon Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup> is the establisher with the command of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, and I testify upon Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> is the establisher with the command of Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>, and I testify upon Musa<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup> is the establisher with the command of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>, and I testify upon Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Musa<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup> is the establisher with the command of Musa<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, and I testify upon Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup> is the establisher with the command of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Musa<sup>asws</sup>, and I testify upon Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup> is the established with the command of Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup>.
And I testify upon Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup> is the establisher with the command of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>, and I testify upon a man from the sons<sup>asws</sup> of Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, who shall neither be teknonymed nor named until his<sup>asws</sup> command appears, so he<sup>asws</sup> would be filling it (the earth) with justice just as it had been filled with tyranny (beforehand), and the greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, and the Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Blessings’. 
Then he arose and went away. So Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>! Follow him and look where he is headed to’. So Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> went out and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It was not so except that he places his left (foot) outside from the Masjid, and it was not known where he was taken from the earth of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, and he<sup>asws</sup> returned to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> and let him<sup>asws</sup> know. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Muhammad! Do you<sup>asws</sup> recognise him?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup> and Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> are more knowing’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He was Al-Khizr<sup>as</sup>’’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people has narrated Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Barqi from abu Hashim Dawud ibn al-Qasim al-Ja‘fari from abu Ja‘far al-Thani who has said the following.

“Once Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) came with al-Hassan and al-Husayn and he was holding the hand of Salman for support. He entered the sacred Mosque in Makka and sat down. Then a good looking and well dressed man came. He offered the greeting of peace to Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) who answered his greetings likewise and he sat down. He then said, “I will ask you three questions. If you would answer them I will acknowledge that the people who have acted against you in the matters of leadership after the Holy Prophet (s.a) they have acted against their own selves. Their actions have taken away peace from them in this world as well in the next life. If it would be otherwise, (you can answer) then you and those people will be the same.”

Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) said, “Ask whatever you would like.” He said, “Tell about the man who sleeps. Where does his spirit go?” Tell about the man, how he remembers and forgets? Tell me about the man how do his children become similar to the aunts and uncles.?” Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) turned to al-Hassan and said, “O abu Muhammad, answer him.” The narrator has said that al-Hassan answered his questions.

The man then said, “I testify that there is no lord besides Allah and I continue to testify to this fact. I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah and I continue to testify to this fact I testify that you are the executor of the will of the Messenger of Allah and that you are the in charge of this task ((Leadership with Divine Authority) with His authorization.” He pointed out to Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) with his hand. He then said, “I continue to testify to this fact.” “I testify that you are the executor of his (Amir al-Mu’minin’s (a.s.) will and the in charge of this task ((Leadership with Divine Authority) by His authorization after him (Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) “ He pointed out with his hand to al-Hassan (a.s.). Then He then said, “I continue to testify to this fact.” “I testify that al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s.) will be the executor of the will of his brother and the in charge of this task ((Leadership with Divine Authority) with His authorization after him.

“I testify in support of Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) that he will be the in charge of the task of al-Husayn after him. “I testify that Muhammad ibn Ali will be the in charge of the task of Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) after him. “I testify that Ja‘far ibn Muhammad (a.s.) will be the in charge of the task of Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s.). “I testify that Musa will be the in charge of the task of Ja‘far ibn Muhammad after him. “I testify that Ali ibn Musa will be the in charge of the task of Musa ibn Ja‘far (a.s.). “I testify that Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s.) will be the in charge of the task of Ali ibn Musa (a.s.) after him. “I testify that Ali ibn Muhammad will be the in charge of the task of Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s.) after him.

“I testify that al-Hassan ibn Ali (a.s.) will be the in charge of the task of Ali ibn Muhammad (a.s.) after him. “I testify in support of a man from the children of al-Hassan who will not be mentioned by his Kunya (father or son of so and so) or his name until he will rise with Divine authority to fill the earth with justice after being filled with injustice. “I offer you my greeting of peace O Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) and praay to Allah to grant you blessings and holiness.”

He then stood up and left. Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) said, “O abu Muhammad follow him and see where went.” Al-Hassan ibn Ali (a.s.) went out to find out (and came back) and said, “As soon as he stepped out of the Mosque I could not figure out in which direction of the earth of Allah ddid he disappear. I returned to Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) and informed him.” He said, “O abu Muhammad, do you know him?” I said, Allah, the Messenger of Allah and Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) know best.” He said, “He was al-Khidr (a.s.) “
